questions.text: According to the position document, the PRIMARY purpose of the Cyber Security Professional IV role is to:
options: Prevent security threats to IT infrastructure through 24/7 monitoring, audits, evaluations, corrective solutions, and continuous improvement
Develop financial accounting software for public finance management
Manage human-resource recruitment for the IT department
Respond to IT helpdesk tickets and repair office computers
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A: Prevent security threats to IT infrastructure through 24/7 monitoring, audits, evaluations, corrective solutions, and continuous improvement

questions.text: The phrase “perform their planned prevention work 24/7” in the purpose statement most directly implies that the Professional must ensure:
options: All systems are shut down every night for 7 hours
Security controls operate continuously with monitoring, alerting, and response coverage at all hours
Staff work 24 hours per day without rest
Audits are conducted only once every 24 months
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B: Security controls operate continuously with monitoring, alerting, and response coverage at all hours

questions.text: Which of the following BEST summarizes the four Results expected from the position?
options: Budgeting, auditing of finances, taxation, and revenue collection
Software coding, hardware repair, networking, and database design
Security management; awareness building; audit/vulnerability mitigation; monitoring current cybersecurity situations
Procurement, payroll, recruitment, and inventory management
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C: Security management; awareness building; audit/vulnerability mitigation; monitoring current cybersecurity situations

questions.section: Result 1: Cyber Security Management (24/7, Defense-in-Depth, Updates, Design Review, Access, Risk)
questions.text: Under Result 1, the Professional is expected to make a plan that is “feasible” to meet cybersecurity needs. A feasible plan is one that is:
options: Focused only on purchasing the most expensive tools
Ambitious regardless of resources, so that goals look impressive on paper
Achievable with available resources, capacity, time, and institutional constraints
Copied unchanged from another country without adaptation
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C: Achievable with available resources, capacity, time, and institutional constraints

questions.section: Result 1: Cyber Security Management (24/7, Defense-in-Depth, Updates, Design Review, Access, Risk)

Limit communication to external vendors only
Identify stakeholders, analyze their roles, and ensure consistency between institutional practices and national cybersecurity requirements
Replace all national policies with personal preferences
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C: Identify stakeholders, analyze their roles, and ensure consistency between institutional practices and national cybersecurity requirements

questions.section: Result 1: Cyber Security Management (24/7, Defense-in-Depth, Updates, Design Review, Access, Risk)

Cleaning services for the server room
Catering and transport services for IT staff
Internet subscription packages from ISPs

New employees to hire without defined roles

questions.section: Result 1: Cyber Security Management (24/7, Defense-in-Depth, Updates, Design Review, Access, Risk)

Deploying multiple layered controls (people, process, technology) so that if one layer fails, others still protect the asset
Relying on a single firewall as the only protection
Installing antivirus on one computer and sharing the license
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B: Deploying multiple layered controls (people, process, technology) so that if one layer fails, others still protect the asset
